summary: PVT characterization report for sky130-opamp (two-stage Miller-compensated op-amp, DR-007 sizing): aggregated worst/best-corner tables over 5 process corners (tt/ff/ss/sf/fs) x 3 temperatures (-40/27/125 C), 45 ngspice runs, 0 failed, each row's verdict naming the per-analysis CSV, the raw ngspice log, and the rendered deck it rests on. COVERAGE IS PARTIAL, AND klt signoff DOES NOT GRADE COVERAGE -- it grades this envelope's status field alone. This status therefore asserts only that the report exists, aggregates every measurement this block has, is current for the committed netlist (design/netlist/opamp_core.spice, unchanged since commit 28815e8, which landed the record and the resize together), and states honestly what it did and did not measure. It asserts NOTHING about spec compliance: that is T1 item 5, which is uncited and unmet. Of spec/target-spec.md section 2's 12 performance rows, 6 ARE CHARACTERIZED here -- open-loop DC gain, GBW, phase margin, slew rate (rise and fall), output swing, quiescent power -- and 6 ARE UNCHARACTERIZED, with no testbench for them committed anywhere under sim/: input-referred noise (ratified as a target only; no noise bench exists and flicker is uncharacterized), input-referred offset (TBD; needs a mismatch Monte Carlo pass, none run), CMRR (TBD; needs a common-mode AC bench, not built), PSRR (TBD; needs a supply-sweep axis, which no committed bench has), input common-mode range (ratified as a target only; the committed dc-swing bench measures closed-loop compliance, which its own README states is not an ICMR measurement), and area (TBD; layout/ holds only a placeholder, so there is no post-layout quantity to report). Two of the 6 characterized rows MEASURE BELOW TARGET at their binding corner and are recorded as such, not laundered by this pass status: slew rate on the FALLING edge, 11.03 V/us at SS/-40 C = 55% of the ~20 V/us target (the rising edge is met, 19.88 V/us at the same corner = 99.4%), and output swing, 0.948 Vpp at SS/-40 C against the ~1.39 Vpp DR-002 estimate = 68%. Per CLAUDE.md no target was relaxed to accommodate either; both gaps are stated at their own rows in spec/target-spec.md section 2, in that file's resize-reconciliation summary, and in DR-007's Consequences section, and the fall-SR residual is diagnosed there as structural (first-stage tail starvation plus a class-A fixed-bias sink). The other 4 characterized rows meet their target at every one of the 15 grid points: open-loop DC gain worst 61.64 dB at FS/125 C against >= 60 dB (1.6 dB of margin, the recorded cost of DR-007's PMOS channel-length trade), GBW worst 17.92 MHz at SS/125 C = 112% of the ~16 MHz target, phase margin worst 63.94 deg at SF/27 C against >= 60 deg, quiescent power worst 131.92 uW at FF/125 C/1.98 V = +2.5% against the ~128.7 uW estimate at that corner. FRESHNESS CAVEAT: klt signoff compares the manifest's pinned content_hash against this envelope's self-declared provenance.input.content_hash and never re-hashes the cited record on disk (klayout-tools#2196, #2403), so that gate is enforced repo-side by .github/workflows/signoff.yml's generic-envelope re-hash step, not by the grader.
